Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks when he hits you with abilities in quick succession, then explodes, so dodge his first ability, especially Brand Q Sear and Brand W Pillar of Flame. While ablaze, being hit by Brand Q Sear stuns you, so move out of its projectile path. When you see Brand R Pyroclasm, spread out from your allies to avoid its bouncing damage.
Brand.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Brand deals mostly magic damage, and Fiddlesticks has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that greatly increase health alone.
Brand.fight: Look for an opportunity to engage after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. Close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of sight, then catch him with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify. If Brand Q Sear could interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, don't start channeling it.
Brand.laning: In the jungle, group monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap, channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end to stay healthy, then move on to the next camp. When ganking, avoid enemy vision and approach from a bush behind the lane or an unseen angle by the river. If a lane has a Control Ward, ask an ally to clear it or gank another lane.
Brand.combo: Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify for after Brand responds or to finish him off.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility ability, so treat the moment Brand W Pillar of Flame is down as your signal to engage. If you're ablaze, Brand Q Sear can stun you, so dodge the projectile before going in. Close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of sight, then lock down Brand with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
Brand.teamfight: Check vision with Scarecrow Effigy before engaging, and spread out from your allies to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm bouncing. If your allies have already applied immobilizing effects or Brand's key response abilities are down, cast Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of sight into narrow terrain where several enemies are grouped. After landing, aim to slow and silence with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end.

Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, you'll be stunned and Amumu can close in, so move with a minion or jungle monster between you. Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns nearby enemies, so keep your distance before Amumu gets close and don't group with allies. Amumu W Despair keeps dealing damage based on your maximum health, so don't stay near him for long.
Amumu.build: Early on, hold out with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Amumu deals mostly magic damage, and Fiddlesticks has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. The true damage from Amumu P Cursed Touch can't be reduced by resistances.
Amumu.fight: Don't start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest if Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy could interrupt it. Keep your distance before Amumu gets close, and lock him down with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify when you engage.
Amumu.combo: If you need to stop Amumu's cast, hit him with the center of Fiddlesticks E Reap to silence him.
Amumu.escape: After Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down, there's a good window to use Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest without interruption. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you have an angle to engage, close in with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and cast Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
Amumu.phase: In the mid game, engages with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and an ability power core item become stronger. In the late game, you still have a role in starting fights around objectives, but choose a spot where the enemy team won't scatter after you engage.
Amumu.teamfight: While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, don't group with your allies; keep your distance in open terrain. After Amumu's key crowd control is down or your allies have already applied immobilizing effects, check vision at the entry point with Scarecrow Effigy, then use Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm on enemies grouped in a narrow area.

Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes in, stuns, and reduces resistances, so check that it's been used before channeling Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest. If Briar channels E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify. Don't fight with your back to a wall, so a fully charged scream can't knock you into it and stun you. If Briar R Certain Death hits you, move toward your allies and fight together instead of fleeing alone.
Briar.build: Build armor first against Briar's main damage from P Crimson Curse, Q Head Rush, and W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. E Chilling Scream and R Certain Death deal magic damage, so armor won't block them. If the fight drags on because of her healing, consider Morellonomicon after building resistances.
Briar.fight: Even if Briar engages with Q Head Rush or W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, check her remaining mobility and crowd control before fighting. If Briar channels E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
Briar.combo: Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify just after Briar Q Head Rush or W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, or to finish her off.
Briar.escape: Don't engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down; check W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and R Certain Death too. Then use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to stop Briar from escaping.
Briar.phase: In the mid game, Fiddlesticks can turn a teamfight around once he has R Crowstorm and an ability power core item, so set up a position to counter Briar's engage. Fiddlesticks can still start fights around objectives in the late game, but engaging becomes dangerous if the enemy team scatters.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so dodge to the side. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush can reset, so create distance. Diana R Moonfall deals more damage the more enemies it pulls in, so don't stand grouped with your allies.
Diana.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Diana deals mostly magic damage, and Fiddlesticks has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Diana.fight: Fight after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear. If Diana uses E Lunar Rush to engage without a Q Crescent Strike mark, catch her with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and slow her with E Reap. Use Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest after damaging the enemy, when you can channel it to the end without interruption.
Diana.combo: Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify for just after Diana uses E Lunar Rush or to finish her off.
Diana.escape: If Diana uses E Lunar Rush first without a mark, it's an opportunity to engage because she has no way to return. Close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of sight, then catch her with Q Terrify. Fiddlesticks also has a good opening to engage after Diana R Moonfall is down or your allies have already applied immobilizing effects.
Diana.phase: From the mid game onward, engaging in teamfights with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is strong, and you still have a role in starting fights around objectives in the late game.
Diana.teamfight: Check vision where you plan to engage with Scarecrow Effigy, and watch the routes Diana could use to flank. Have your allies spread out relative to her entry direction so they aren't all pulled in by Diana R Moonfall. When the enemy team is grouped in a narrow area, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of sight after your allies have applied immobilizing effects or the enemy's key response abilities are down.

Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Ekko Q Timewinder deals more damage on the return hit, so move out of its return path. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don’t chase recklessly just because he’s low on health.
Ekko.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Ekko’s main damage is magic, and Fiddlesticks has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Ekko’s healing becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Ekko.fight: Respond with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive. If Ekko W Parallel Convergence could stun you, don’t start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest.
Ekko.escape: If only Ekko E Phase Dive is on cooldown, don’t go in too soon; Ekko can still escape with Ekko R Chronobreak. Your window to engage is before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back, and the fight is safer if Ekko W Parallel Convergence is also on cooldown. Then close the distance with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to prevent his escape.
Ekko.phase: In the mid game, once you have Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and your core ability power items, one engage can turn a teamfight around. In the late game, keep looking to start fights around objectives, but don’t chase Ekko just because he’s low if Ekko R Chronobreak is ready.
Ekko.teamfight: Before a teamfight or objective fight, use a Scarecrow Effigy to check enemy vision, then choose an entry point where several enemies are grouped and there’s little room to retreat. Use Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of sight after an ally lands crowd control or the enemy’s key response abilities are on cooldown. After landing, slow the enemies, including Ekko, with Fiddlesticks E Reap; use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify on anyone who can retaliate, then fully channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest.

Evelynn.watch: If Evelynn W Allure marks you, she’s nearby and preparing to charm you, so retreat into your team’s vision before the mark matures. Don’t use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify while Evelynn is casting Evelynn R Last Caress, because she can’t be targeted then.
Evelynn.build: Evelynn’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Evelynn.fight: Retreat before Evelynn W Allure’s mark matures. You can use Fiddlesticks E Reap along her expected entry path to deal damage. After Evelynn R Last Caress is on cooldown, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of sight and use Q Terrify to stop her escape. Don’t start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest if you can’t channel it fully.
Evelynn.laning: At jungle camps, group monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then fully channel W Bountiful Harvest to maintain your health and clear speed. Place a regular ward beside Evelynn’s jungle camps to watch where fights begin, and avoid enemy vision when approaching for a gank.
Evelynn.escape: If only Evelynn E Whiplash is on cooldown, don’t rush in; she can still escape with Evelynn R Last Caress. Before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back, close the distance with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and use Q Terrify. Don’t engage while Evelynn W Allure’s mark is maturing; retreat instead.
Evelynn.phase: In the mid game, once you have Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and core ability power items, you can turn a teamfight around with an engage from out of sight. In the late game, keep looking to start fights around objectives and choose a spot where the enemy can’t spread out.

Elise.watch: Be especially careful of Elise Q Neurotoxin while she’s at full health, and Elise Q Venomous Bite after her health drops and she transforms into spider form. Don’t use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify while Elise is airborne with Elise E Rappel; wait for her to land.
Elise.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Elise’s main damage is magic, and the stun from Elise E Cocoon is also dangerous, so prioritize magic resistance and tenacity. If healing from Elise P Spider Queen becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Elise.fight: If Elise E Cocoon is available, it can interrupt the channel of Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, so wait for the right moment to use them. If Elise goes airborne with Elise E Rappel, save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and use it after she lands.
Elise.laning: Fiddlesticks groups jungle monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then fully channels Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to stay healthy while clearing camps. When ganking, approach from out of enemy vision. If the lane has a Control Ward, ask someone to clear it or go to another lane.
Elise.escape: Right after Elise uses Elise Q Venomous Bite is your chance to close the distance. Engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of sight and catch her with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify. If both Elise E Rappel and Elise E Cocoon are on cooldown, start a fight while Elise has difficulty escaping or interrupting Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest.
Elise.phase: Early on, watch for Elise trying to build an advantage through ganks. Don’t give up kills, and stall for time. In the late game, keep engaging with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm in objective fights, but choose a spot where the enemy can’t spread out.

Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates as soon as it hits terrain, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall or in narrow jungle passages. If you’re caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, leave the area by the shortest route. Block Graves’s basic attacks by keeping minions or allies between you and him.
Graves.build: Graves’s main damage is physical, so buy Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first. If you’re likely to take focused fire right after engaging, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass early to keep Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm’s damage over time going.
Graves.fight: When Graves has fired both shots and is reloading, you have a chance to fight back or create distance.
Graves.laning: In the jungle, group monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then fully channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to maintain your health and clear speed. Apply pressure with out-of-sight ganks from the early game, but clear vision on lanes with a Control Ward or gank another lane to limit Graves’s time to scale.
Graves.escape: If only Graves E Quickdraw is on cooldown, don’t rush in; he can still escape with Graves R Collateral Damage. Engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm especially before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back, when an ally has landed crowd control or the enemy’s key response abilities are on cooldown.
Graves.phase: Early on, pressure Graves with out-of-sight ganks to slow his scaling. In the mid game, use Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and core ability power items to start teamfights. Keep looking for objective fights in the late game, but be wary of Graves as he grows stronger over time.
Graves.teamfight: Use a Scarecrow Effigy to check vision at the entry point, then prepare Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of sight where several enemies are grouped and there’s little room to retreat. Engage after an ally lands crowd control or the enemy’s key response abilities are on cooldown. Slow and silence enemies with Fiddlesticks E Reap, use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify on anyone who can retaliate, then fully channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest.

Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, move out of its radius immediately. If Gragas E Body Slam also hits you near the barrel, you’ll take damage in quick succession, so don’t start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest there. When Gragas has Gragas R Explosive Cask ready, don’t stand with your back to an enemy turret or the enemy team.
Gragas.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to help you survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Gragas’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If healing from Gragas P Happy Hour becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Gragas.fight: Gragas W Drunken Rage reduces the damage he takes while he drinks, so save your burst until its effect ends. Right after baiting out Gragas E Body Slam, close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision and catch him with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify. Damage him first, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end when it won’t be interrupted.
Gragas.combo: Start ganks with Fiddlesticks E Reap from out of vision to trigger its automatic fear, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end when you won’t be interrupted. Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right after Gragas E Body Slam or to finish him off.
Gragas.escape: The moment Gragas E Body Slam is down is your window to engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. After landing, use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to keep Gragas from escaping. If Gragas still has his key response abilities, bait them out before you engage.
Gragas.phase: In early and mid-game objective fights, hold your formation and survive. Once Fiddlesticks has Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and an ability power core item in mid game, he can turn a team fight around. He also plays a role in starting objective fights in late game.
Gragas.teamfight: Don’t let your backline stand alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam. If it hits, move out of Gragas Q Barrel Roll’s radius immediately. Check vision with Scarecrow Effigy, then use Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision in a narrow area when an ally has applied crowd control or Gragas’s key response abilities are down. After landing, silence enemies with the center of Fiddlesticks E Reap, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end.

Hecarim.build: Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge deal mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm deal damage over time, letting you keep Grievous Wounds applied for longer.
Hecarim.fight: When a fight starts, disrupt Hecarim’s movement with the slow from Fiddlesticks E Reap or Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to reduce both his ability to engage and his damage. Don’t start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest if Hecarim’s knockback or fear could interrupt it.
Hecarim.combo: Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify for right after Hecarim E Devastating Charge or Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, or to finish him off.
Hecarim.escape: If only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down, he can still escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, so don’t rush your engage. Look for a window before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back, and close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision. Follow with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to keep Hecarim from escaping.
Hecarim.phase: In mid game, look for a chance to turn a team fight around with an engage from out of vision once you have Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and your core ability power items. Keep playing a role in starting objective fights in late game, and choose a spot where the enemy team can’t spread out.
Hecarim.teamfight: Before a team fight, use Scarecrow Effigy to check vision and enemy positions at your planned engage point. Have your allies spread out so they aren’t all hit by Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows. Once an ally has applied crowd control or Hecarim’s key response abilities are down, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm where enemies are clustered and have little room to retreat.

JarvanIV.build: If the enemy has high burst physical damage, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier to weather the focus fire right after you engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm.
JarvanIV.laning: In jungle camps, Fiddlesticks groups monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then channels Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end to maintain his health and clear speed. When ganking, circle around from out of enemy vision. If a lane is warded, clear the vision or choose another lane.
JarvanIV.combo: In team fights, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision, then slow and silence enemies with Fiddlesticks E Reap. Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify on a target who could retaliate, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end.

Ivern.watch: If you’re rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern’s allies can dash in, so avoid giving him an angle by keeping terrain between you and him before he throws it. Don’t engage immediately on a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed; account for the slow after it detonates. When Ivern R Daisy! starts hitting you, move away to avoid being knocked up by her consecutive attacks.
Ivern.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Ivern deals mostly magic damage, and Fiddlesticks has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Tenacity is also important when allies can follow up on Ivern Q Rootcaller’s root or Ivern R Daisy!’s knockup.
Ivern.fight: The window to close the gap comes after Ivern Q Rootcaller is down and Ivern E Triggerseed has detonated. Engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of enemy vision, then hit with the center of Fiddlesticks E Reap to silence enemies and prevent retaliation. Use Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest when you can channel it to the end without interruption.
Ivern.laning: In jungle camps, Fiddlesticks groups monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap and channels Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end to maintain his health and keep his route going. Early on, get vision in Ivern’s jungle to track his path back to camps where he planted seeds. When ganking, approach from out of enemy vision, and don’t walk carelessly beside brush that suddenly appears from Ivern W Brushmaker.
Ivern.combo: Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify for right after Ivern Q Rootcaller or to finish him off.
Ivern.escape: Ivern Q Rootcaller is his way to move in, so close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm right after baiting it out. Once key disruption like Ivern R Daisy!’s knockup is also down, you can channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end. After engaging, use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to keep Ivern from escaping.
Ivern.phase: In mid game, once Fiddlesticks has Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and an ability power core item, he can turn a team fight around with a single engage. He can still start objective fights in late game, so wait for a spot where the enemy team will struggle to spread out.

Jax.watch: Jax Q Leap Strike lets him close in by jumping off a minion or ward, so watch your distance around them. Jax E Counter Strike can be reactivated to stun in an area and interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest. If Counter Strike is active, move outside its stun radius and wait for it to end.
Jax.build: The source does not specify Fiddlesticks’ first purchase, so no specific item can be recommended. Consider defensive tools that reduce Jax’s basic attack damage and attack speed. Build both armor and magic resistance to withstand the physical damage from Jax Q Leap Strike and the magic damage from Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a lot of health.
Jax.fight: Keep trades short instead of fighting Jax for a long time and letting him land repeated basic attacks. When Jax E Counter Strike is active, leave its stun radius. After it ends, hold him with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion. Use Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm to engage from out of vision after Jax’s response abilities are down.
Jax.combo: Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify for just after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike or to finish him off. In teamfights, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision, then hit Fiddlesticks E Reap and, after avoiding Jax’s stun, channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion.
Jax.escape: Just after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike is your chance to catch up to him. If Jax E Counter Strike’s stun is also down, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision and hold Jax with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.

Kayn.watch: Dodge the line skillshot from Kayn W Blade's Reach. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your maximum health, so decide whether to continue fighting when you see the dash.
Kayn.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, W Blade's Reach, and R Umbral Trespass. If his burst is strong, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to survive the focus fire right after engaging with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. Consider Morellonomicon if Kayn has transformed into a Darkin and his healing is a problem.
Kayn.fight: Approach from out of vision to fear him first, then fight after dealing damage to Kayn when you can channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion. If Kayn W Blade's Reach can interrupt you, do not start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest. You can immediately interrupt Kayn E Shadow Step as he passes through a wall with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
Kayn.combo: Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify just after Kayn moves with Kayn Q Reaping Slash or R Umbral Trespass, or save it to finish him off. In teamfights, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision, then use E Reap to apply a slow and a central silence, cast Q Terrify on the target who can retaliate, and channel W Bountiful Harvest.
Kayn.phase: By mid game, Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and ability power core items can let you turn a teamfight with one engage. You still play a role in starting objective fights late game, but it is hard to survive after engaging if the enemy is spread out.
Kayn.teamfight: Check vision at your entry point with Fiddlesticks’ Scarecrow Effigy, then set up Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm in a tight area where several enemies are grouped and there is little room to retreat. Engage after an ally’s crowd control lands first or key response abilities such as Kayn W Blade's Reach are down, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion. If Kayn R Umbral Trespass has entered an ally, be ready to cast Fiddlesticks Q Terrify when Kayn emerges near the target.

Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals heavy damage if it hits you alone, so watch its detonation warning and walk out of it. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces magic resistance and slows you, so go around the wall. Even after killing Karthus, avoid the spells he casts with Karthus P Death Defied by moving straight away from his corpse, and keep enough health to survive Karthus R Requiem.
Karthus.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Karthus deals mostly magic damage, and Fiddlesticks has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize building magic resistance.
Karthus.fight: Karthus cannot create distance on his own, so look for a chance to close in with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision. After dealing damage first, channeling Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion lets you make use of its damage based on his missing health.
Karthus.combo: Engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision to apply the automatic fear, then hit the center of Fiddlesticks E Reap immediately after landing to silence Karthus. Follow with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to deal damage again, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage when you have a route that avoids stepping into Karthus W Wall of Pain. If he lays the wall, go around it first, then close the distance and hold Karthus with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
Karthus.phase: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm can turn teamfights in the mid game, but Karthus can catch up with fast farming if he falls behind. In late-game objective fights, look for an opening to engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and account for Karthus’s damage after death.

Khazix.watch: Be ready to use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify when Kha'Zix comes in with Kha'Zix E Leap. When Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, do not chase his position; use Fiddlesticks E Reap along his expected path or cast Q Terrify as he reappears.
Khazix.build: Kha'Zix’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If you need to survive his burst, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to withstand the focus fire right after engaging with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. Consider Morellonomicon if healing from Kha'Zix W Void Spike is a problem.
Khazix.fight: After Kha'Zix E Leap is down, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision and hold him with Q Terrify. Damage him first, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion without letting it be interrupted.
Khazix.combo: Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify for just after Kha'Zix leaps or to finish him off.
Khazix.escape: The moment after Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap to engage is your window to retaliate. Hold him with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify then, and you can close the distance with R Crowstorm from out of vision. Reconsider engaging if an ally is picked off first, since that could reset Kha'Zix E Leap’s cooldown.
Khazix.phase: In the mid game, Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and ability power core items can turn a teamfight, but avoid acting alone against a Kha'Zix who has two or more evolutions. Fiddlesticks still plays a role in securing vision and starting objective fights late game.
Khazix.teamfight: Stay with allies to prevent isolation, and do not leave vision one at a time. After an ally’s crowd control lands first or key response tools such as Kha'Zix E Leap are down, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision in narrow terrain. After landing, use E Reap to apply slow and silence, cast Q Terrify on the target who can retaliate, then channel W Bountiful Harvest to completion.

LeeSin.watch: Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will can get him over walls, so stand away from walls where you have no vision. In team fights, position yourself so Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage cannot knock you into open space.
LeeSin.fight: If you encounter Lee Sin in the early jungle, back away instead of taking the duel. If Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is available, save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify with that mobility spell in mind.
LeeSin.combo: Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right after Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will moves him, or to finish him off.

Lillia.combo: Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify for right after Lillia uses Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, or to finish her off.
Lillia.escape: The moment after Lillia uses Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is your chance to close the gap. Enter with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from an area without vision and apply Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to make it difficult for Lillia to escape. If Lillia's key response abilities are still available, wait until she uses them before engaging.
Lillia.teamfight: Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to catch Lillia when she comes in from the flank. If an ally has already immobilized the enemy or their key response abilities are down, check vision with a Scarecrow Effigy, then cast Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from over a wall or from brush. After landing, silence with the center of Fiddlesticks E Reap, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end.

Kindred.fight: Deal damage from outside vision to trigger the passive fear from Fiddlesticks Q Terrify, then fight once you've lowered Kindred's health and can channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end. Don't rush in just because Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down; Kindred can escape with her remaining mobility. The window before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back is your chance to close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm.
Kindred.laning: In the jungle, group monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end to maintain your health and clear speed. Take camps marked by Kindred P Mark of the Kindred first, or establish vision nearby to delay Kindred from collecting the mark. When ganking, avoid enemy vision and approach through a brush behind the lane or a blind spot by the river.
Kindred.combo: Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify for right after Kindred uses Kindred Q Dance of Arrows or Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, or to finish her off.
Kindred.escape: Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy are both escape tools, so don't rush in when only one is down. In particular, close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back, then use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to prevent her escape. If Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied and your health is low, stop fighting and create distance or break vision.
Kindred.phase: At this point, secure vision and delay Kindred P Mark of the Kindred instead of forcing a direct fight. In the mid game, an engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and an ability power core item is strong, and you continue to open objective fights late.
Kindred.teamfight: Use a Scarecrow Effigy to check vision at your entry point, and prepare Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm where the enemy is grouped and has little room to retreat. Engage after an ally has immobilized them or the enemy's key response abilities are down, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end. When Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, enter its area and survive alongside low-health allies, then receive the heal when it ends.

MasterYi.watch: While Master Yi uses Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, he can't be targeted, so use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right after he lands. If Master Yi R Highlander is active, Fiddlesticks E Reap's slow can't create distance, so respond with fear. Also watch out for the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style.
MasterYi.build: If you need to enter with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm while being focused, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. If the healing from Master Yi W Meditate is a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
MasterYi.fight: The moment after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is used is your chance to close the gap. Don't start channeling if Master Yi can interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest.
MasterYi.combo: If Master Yi uses Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, cast Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right after he lands.
MasterYi.escape: Right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is used, enter with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from outside vision. Engage after an ally has applied an immobilizing effect or the enemy's key response abilities are down to create an opportunity to channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi is weak in the jungle and at ganking early, so secure vision and gain an advantage at objectives. Continue to open objective fights late, but don't give Master Yi, who gets stronger as the game goes on, takedown participation.
MasterYi.teamfight: Use a Scarecrow Effigy to check vision at your entry point, and choose a spot where the enemy is grouped and has difficulty scattering. Right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, lock down his initial engage with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify. If Master Yi uses Master Yi W Meditate, interrupt it with the center silence from Fiddlesticks E Reap. Layer crowd control with your team and channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end without giving Master Yi his first takedown participation.

MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted, so dodge it by staying out of range. Don’t use abilities on the stationary clone left by Wukong W Warrior Trickster; watch where the real Wukong moves.
MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against Wukong’s main physical damage, and get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier if his burst is strong. If healing from Wukong P Stone Skin becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon to maintain Grievous Wounds with the damage over time from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong builds up armor and healing the longer he fights, so trade briefly and back off. Once both Wukong W Warrior Trickster and Wukong E Nimbus Strike are on cooldown, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision and use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to prevent his escape.
MonkeyKing.laning: Ask an ally to clear a lane with a Control Ward or rotate to another lane. In jungle camps, group the monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap and channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end.
MonkeyKing.combo: Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify for after Wukong uses W Warrior Trickster or E Nimbus Strike, or for the finish.
MonkeyKing.escape: If only Wukong W Warrior Trickster is on cooldown, he can still escape with Wukong E Nimbus Strike, so look for an opening after both are used. In particular, close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify before Wukong W Warrior Trickster returns. There’s also an opportunity to fight or contest an objective right after Wukong R Cyclone is used.
MonkeyKing.phase: In the mid game, Fiddlesticks can turn a team fight around with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and ability power core items. Keep vision in the late game too, and look for an opening to engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm in objective fights.

Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther it travels, so sidestep its path and, if possible, keep minions or your frontline between you and Nidalee. Avoid the traps from Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce as well so you can start fights without a Hunt mark. If marked and Nidalee dives in with Pounce, be ready to use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
Nidalee.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance because most of Nidalee’s damage is magic. If healing from Nidalee E Primal Surge / Swipe becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Nidalee.fight: Right after Nidalee uses W Bushwhack / Pounce, catch her with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify or close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision.
Nidalee.combo: Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right after Nidalee moves with W Bushwhack / Pounce or to finish her off. In team fights, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, hit with Fiddlesticks E Reap as soon as you land, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end.
Nidalee.escape: The moment after you make Nidalee use W Bushwhack / Pounce is your chance to close the gap. Engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision and apply Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to make it difficult for Nidalee to escape. Nidalee has no crowd control, so watch whether she has used her mobility ability before you engage.
Nidalee.phase: In the mid game, once you have Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and ability power core items, one engage can turn a team fight around. You can still engage in late-game objective fights, but choose your position first, since it’s dangerous if the enemy team spreads out.

Poppy.laning: Keep your back away from walls and narrow passages to avoid the wall stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge. Step on the shield dropped by Poppy P Iron Ambassador first to prevent her from gaining a shield. When ganking, approach outside enemy vision; if there’s a Control Ward, ask an ally to clear it or help another lane.
Poppy.combo: Once Poppy E Heroic Charge is on cooldown, use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to lock her down again or finish her off.
Poppy.phase: In the mid game, once you have Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and ability power core items, one engage can turn a team fight around. In the late game, you can still start objective fights, but choose a spot where the enemy team can’t spread out.

Rammus.watch: If you see Rammus Q Powerball, put minions between you and him in advance to block his approach. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt can interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, so don’t start channeling while Rammus is close. If Rammus uses R Soaring Slam after quickly engaging with Q Powerball, give the area a wide berth and leave the landing spot immediately too.
Rammus.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Rammus’s main magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots to reduce the time you’re held by crowd control.
Rammus.fight: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, don’t commit all your damage; look for an opening right after it ends. Fight outside the range of Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and only start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest when you can channel it to the end without interruption.
Rammus.combo: Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right after Rammus moves with R Soaring Slam or to finish him off.
Rammus.escape: The window after Rammus R Soaring Slam is used is your chance to engage. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is also on cooldown, close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision and catch him with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
Rammus.phase: In the mid game, Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm can turn a team fight around, and you can play that role in late-game objective fights too. Fiddlesticks becomes vulnerable if the enemy team spreads out after you engage, so choose your entry point carefully.

RekSai.watch: If Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow knocks you up as she erupts from the ground, it can interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest. When you spot her Burrow, leave the narrow path and move into open space. Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel deals true damage, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't recklessly stay close just because you still have health. Rek'Sai can't be targeted while leaping with R Void Rush, so use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify after she lands.
RekSai.build: Build armor first against Rek'Sai's main damage, and get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier if her burst physical damage is a problem. Armor can't reduce the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush scales with your maximum health, so be cautious about choices that only add a lot of health. If healing from Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai is a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
RekSai.laning: Early on, don't walk alone through areas without vision or push your lane too hard, so Rek'Sai can't get kills from ganks. Walk over visible Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel entrances to destroy them. Fiddlesticks can group monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion to stay healthy and move on to the next camp.
RekSai.combo: Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify for right after Rek'Sai uses E Furious Bite / Tunnel or R Void Rush, or to finish her off. In teamfights, engage from out of sight with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, then use Fiddlesticks E Reap to apply a slow and silence in the center. Cast Fiddlesticks Q Terrify on the target who can retaliate, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion.
RekSai.escape: A good window to engage is after Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow's knock-up is used and before Rek'Sai R Void Rush is ready again. If only Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can still escape with another mobility ability, so check for those before closing the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and catching her with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
RekSai.phase: Early on, Rek'Sai can build an advantage easily with ganks, so Fiddlesticks should avoid risky fights and buy time. From mid game, once Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and an ability power core item are ready, you can turn teamfights around with an engage from out of sight. Fiddlesticks can still initiate fights around objectives late game, but engaging where the enemy can spread out is dangerous.

Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up, so instead of running forward, walk toward the snowball and escape through the area Nunu & Willump passed. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, move away immediately before its delayed root lands. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, interrupt the channel with the center of Fiddlesticks E Reap or leave its area.
Nunu.build: Survive early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nunu & Willump's damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first. If healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume is a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Nunu.fight: If Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! or Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage could interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, don't start channeling. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance on their own, so close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm when you see an opening to engage.
Nunu.escape: Engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm after dodging Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever!'s knock-up and Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage's root, or after those abilities have been used. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance on their own, so after catching them, use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to limit their chance to escape.
Nunu.phase: In mid game, once Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and an ability power core item are ready, clear vision and prepare to engage in teamfights. Fiddlesticks can still initiate fights around objectives late game, but choose narrow terrain where the enemy can't spread out after you engage.

Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator's leap from brush also builds his resource, so avoid passing beside brush when Rengar is out of sight. When his resource bar is full, Rengar E Bola Strike roots and Rengar W Battle Roar can remove crowd control, so don't start a trade then. If Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is active, don't walk alone; stay behind your team's frontline.
Rengar.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Rengar Q Savagery, Rengar E Bola Strike, and Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt. If his burst is strong, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to weather the focus fire just after Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm engages. If healing from Rengar W Battle Roar is a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar's resource bar is empty or Rengar W Battle Roar is on cooldown. If Rengar E Bola Strike's root is still available, wait before engaging with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm.
Rengar.combo: In teamfights, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and immediately hit enemies with the center of Fiddlesticks E Reap after landing to silence them. Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify on a target who can retaliate, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion.
Rengar.escape: An opening to engage appears if Rengar P Unseen Predator's leap has already been used and Rengar E Bola Strike is also on cooldown. Confirm that Rengar W Battle Roar has been used, then catch him with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify. Prepare Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of sight to close the gap at that moment.
Rengar.teamfight: Stand behind your team's frontline and within vision to prepare for Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt's leap. Use Scarecrow Effigy to check vision at the engagement point, then use Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm in narrow terrain after an ally's immobilizing effect lands first or Rengar's key response abilities are used.

Sejuani.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Sejuani's main damage is magic and Fiddlesticks has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Sejuani.fight: Right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is used is Fiddlesticks' chance to close the gap. If Sejuani's Frost Armor is active, deal damage to let her slow immunity wear off before relying on the slow from Fiddlesticks E Reap.
Sejuani.combo: If Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is on cooldown, save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and use it to prevent her from escaping.
Sejuani.escape: Right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is used, a window opens to engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. Choose a moment when Sejuani R Glacial Prison is also on cooldown or an ally's immobilizing effect has landed first, then use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to prevent Sejuani from escaping.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, Sejuani has low kill and damage stats, giving you room to take jungle control and objectives and delay her item timings. In mid game, engages with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and an ability power core item become strong, and Fiddlesticks can still initiate fights around objectives late game.

Shaco.fight: Open with Fiddlesticks E Reap from out of vision to trigger the automatic fear, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion when Shaco W Jack In The Box or other effects can’t interrupt it. If Shaco uses Q Deceive to engage and reveals himself, focus fire with your team immediately and catch him with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
Shaco.laning: In the early jungle, group monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion to maintain your health and clear speed. Ward your jungle entrances to watch for Shaco invades, and gank from positions where you can approach outside enemy vision.
Shaco.combo: For ganks, trigger the automatic fear with Fiddlesticks E Reap from out of vision, then use Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest. If Shaco Q Deceive is down, catch him with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify or finish him off. In teamfights, enter with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision, then chain Fiddlesticks E Reap and Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest.
Shaco.phase: Early on, Shaco will look to gain an advantage through ganks and invades, so avoid giving up kills, maintain vision, and secure objectives. From mid game onward, Fiddlesticks can turn teamfights with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and take the role of starting objective fights in the late game too. Shaco’s ability to fight alone in the late game is weaker if he fails to get an early lead.

Shyvana.watch: Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is unstoppable during its dash, so don’t try to stop the engage with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify; use it after she lands. Dodge Shyvana E Molten Burst, which slows and deals damage based on maximum health, and keep your distance so you don’t take extended damage from Shyvana Q Emberstrike and Shyvana W Inferno Aegis.
Shyvana.build: Shyvana’s main damage is magic, and Fiddlesticks has relatively low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. If healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon to maintain Grievous Wounds with the damage over time from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm.
Shyvana.fight: Watch for Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent and keep your distance. Once Shyvana lands, catch her with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify, then damage her and channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion without interruption. Look for an opportunity to pressure her when her Fury is empty or she has returned to human form.
Shyvana.combo: If Shyvana has used Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, wait until she lands before using Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
Shyvana.escape: Engage when Shyvana’s Fury is empty or after she has already used Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent. Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify while Shyvana is dashing, and use it after she lands. Use Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from an unwarded area after your team lands crowd control or the enemy’s key response abilities are down.
Shyvana.phase: Early on, pressure Shyvana before she has stacks and take camps and objectives first. In mid game, look for teamfights with an engage from out of vision after getting Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and your ability power core items. Fiddlesticks can still start objective fights in the late game, but Shyvana becomes stronger with permanent stacks, making her harder to catch with the same engage angle.

Skarner.build: Early on, survive with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Prioritize magic resistance against Skarner’s main damage, but remember it won’t block the physical damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval or Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Decide in advance whether to include Quicksilver Sash in your build to counter the suppression from Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.fight: After Skarner uses E Ixtal’s Impact, you have an opportunity to close the distance with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. Enter from outside enemy vision and lock down Skarner with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion when you can’t be interrupted. Don’t start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest if Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact or Skarner R Impale is still available to interrupt it.
Skarner.combo: Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right after Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact or to finish him off.

Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley locks her casting direction, so dodge by moving to the side instead of approaching in a straight line. When entering with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, choose an angle that avoids crossing her worked ground.
Taliyah.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Taliyah’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads.
Taliyah.combo: Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify for when Taliyah tries to escape with E Unraveled Earth or R Weaver’s Wall. In teamfights, enter with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of vision, then slow enemies and silence those in the center with Fiddlesticks E Reap. Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify on whoever can retaliate, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest.
Taliyah.escape: Don’t engage just because Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down. Close the distance with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm when Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall is still unavailable and you can avoid interference from Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Once you’re close, use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to stop Taliyah from escaping.
Taliyah.phase: In mid game, an engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and ability power core items can turn a teamfight. Continue starting objective fights in the late game, but don’t enter where Taliyah’s response could scatter the enemy team.

Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede closes the gap quickly and stuns, so keep your distance right after Udyr changes stance. During Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s awakening, crowd control does not work, so use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify after the awakening ends. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid staying close and taking hits for long.
Udyr.build: Build armor first to account for Udyr’s main damage. However, armor does not block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types, so avoid stacking only health. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Udyr.fight: Keep your distance before Udyr gets on top of you, and save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to stop his approach. Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle expires, slow him with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then focus your damage.
Udyr.combo: If Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and block his escape with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify after the awakening ends. Channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end when Udyr cannot interrupt it with his stun.
Udyr.escape: The moment after you make Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your window to go in with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. After the stun applies once, it cannot affect the same target again for a while, so counterattack or escape during that window. Cast Fiddlesticks Q Terrify after Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s awakening ends.

Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage the longer it is charged and closes the gap with a dash, so move backward or sideways to dodge when you see her charging. Vi R Cease and Desist chases its target all the way and knocks them up, so don’t try to dodge it with Flash; once you land and the knock-up ends, use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to create distance.
Vi.build: Build armor first because Vi’s main damage is physical. If her burst is strong, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier to weather the focus fire right after you engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. Vi W Denting Blows reduces armor and deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking only health.
Vi.fight: Don’t let Vi W Denting Blows hit you with repeated attacks for long; fight briefly, then create distance. The moment after you dodge or make Vi use Vi Q Vault Breaker is your chance to engage; use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify then to stop her counterattack. Don’t start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest when Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist can interrupt it.
Vi.escape: The moment after you dodge or make Vi use Vi Q Vault Breaker is your window to go in. If Vi R Cease and Desist is still available, don’t waste Fiddlesticks Q Terrify while she is charging toward you; use it after you land and the knock-up ends.
Vi.phase: In mid game, you can turn a teamfight around with an engage once you have Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and your ability power core items. In late game, keep opening fights around objectives, but choose a spot where the enemy team cannot scatter.
Vi.teamfight: Send out Scarecrow Effigy first to check vision and Vi’s position, then prepare Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from beyond a wall or from a brush outside vision. Once responses such as Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist are down, or an ally has landed crowd control first, engage into narrow terrain where several enemies are grouped.

Warwick.build: In the early game, build Null-Magic Mantle first to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first to account for the damage and healing from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. If healing becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon to maintain grievous wounds with the damage over time from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm.
Warwick.combo: For ganks, hit with Fiddlesticks E Reap from outside vision to trigger the passive fear, and start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest during that window. Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify for right after Warwick moves with Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast or Warwick R Infinite Duress, or to finish him off. In teamfights, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from outside vision, hit with Fiddlesticks E Reap, use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify on the target who can retaliate, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end.
Warwick.escape: Don’t engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. Look for a window before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back, and close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm after the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl has also been used. Then use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to keep Warwick from escaping.
Warwick.phase: In mid game, you can turn a teamfight around with a single engage once you have Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and your ability power core items. In late game, keep opening engages in fights around objectives, but choose a spot where the enemy team cannot scatter.
Warwick.teamfight: Use Scarecrow Effigy to check vision and choose an entry point in narrow terrain where several enemies are grouped. Once an ally has landed crowd control first or key responses such as Warwick E Primal Howl and Warwick R Infinite Duress are down, use Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from outside vision. After landing, stop counterattacks with Fiddlesticks E Reap and Fiddlesticks Q Terrify, and protect the Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest channel until it ends.

Viego.watch: The stun from Viego W Spectral Maw lasts longer the more it is charged, so dodge sideways when you see him charging, and interrupt it with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify if he is in range. If Viego E Harrowed Path is visible on terrain, Viego may be camouflaged there, so avoid that path. When your health is low, move back because you may be targeted by Viego R Heartbreaker.
Viego.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If you’re focused right after engaging, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier to preserve the damage over time from Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. If healing from Viego P Sovereign’s Domination and Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King is a problem, get Morellonomicon.
Viego.combo: Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to catch Viego after he moves with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker, or to interrupt Viego W Spectral Maw’s charge. In teamfights, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from outside vision and hit with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then use Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end when you can protect the channel.
Viego.escape: Don’t engage just because Viego W Spectral Maw is down. Close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm in the window before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back, when Viego also cannot use the stun from Viego W Spectral Maw. Then use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to deny Viego time to escape.
Viego.phase: In mid game, you can turn a teamfight around with an engage from outside vision once you have Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and your ability power core items. In late game, keep opening fights around objectives, but choose a spot where the enemy team cannot scatter.

Zac.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zac's damage is mostly magic, so prioritize magic resistance. If his healing becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Zac.fight: If Zac's knock-up could interrupt your W, wait it out. Then damage him and channel all the way through.
Zac.laning: In the jungle, use Fiddlesticks E Reap to group monsters and fully channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to maintain your health and clear speed. Approach ganks along routes hidden from enemy vision. If a lane has a Control Ward, ask for it to be cleared or rotate to another lane.
Zac.escape: The moment after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is used is your chance to engage. If the opponent's key response abilities are also down, close the distance from out of vision with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and lock Zac down with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
Zac.teamfight: Use Scarecrow Effigy to check vision at your entry point, then cast Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm in tight terrain after Zac engages or uses his key response abilities. Right after landing, aim to silence with the center of Fiddlesticks E Reap, cast Fiddlesticks Q Terrify on the necessary target, then keep Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest from being interrupted. If Zac revives and his split blobs are nearby, hit them along with him using area damage.

XinZhao.watch: Dodge the rear thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving sideways. Be especially careful because being hit by the thrust increases Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge's engage range. If you've been hit twice by Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike's empowered attacks, get out of range before the third attack knocks you up.
XinZhao.build: Prioritize armor against Xin Zhao's main damage. Keep in mind that armor does not block the magic damage from Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If you're focused right after engaging, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. If healing from Xin Zhao P Determination becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
XinZhao.fight: Deal damage from out of vision to trigger your passive fear, then catch Xin Zhao with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is used. Don't start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest if Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike's third attack or the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard could interrupt it. When Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active and damage from outside its boundary won't work, create distance and wait out its duration before counterattacking.
XinZhao.laning: In the early jungle, use Fiddlesticks E Reap to group monsters and fully channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to maintain your health and clear speed. Start ganks from out of vision by looping behind the lane through a brush or a blind spot by the river. If a lane is under enemy vision, ask an ally to clear it or rotate to another lane.
XinZhao.combo: Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right after Xin Zhao uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge or when finishing him off.
XinZhao.escape: The moment after you bait Xin Zhao into using Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is your chance to engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. Delay your engage if Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike's third attack could reach and interrupt you. There's also an opening to counterattack after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.phase: From the mid game, once Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and core Ability Power items are ready, one engage can turn a team fight around. Keep starting objective team fights in the late game, and look to counterattack the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.teamfight: First, use Scarecrow Effigy to check vision at your entry point. Prepare Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm where enemies are grouped and have little room to retreat. Engage after an ally's immobilizing effect lands or Xin Zhao uses his key response abilities. After landing, use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap to stop counterattacks and keep Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest channeling to the end.

Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge's cooldown, so if she gets close, dodge by turning sideways instead of retreating in a straight line. While Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, incoming damage is greatly reduced, so save Fiddlesticks' damage abilities until it ends.
Belveth.build: Prioritize armor, since Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom deal physical damage. If you're hit by concentrated fire right after engaging, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. If Bel'Veth's healing becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon. Resistance cannot block the true damage from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet.
Belveth.fight: If Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, don't unload your damage; wait for it to end. Don't start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest if Bel'Veth W Above and Below could interrupt it.
Belveth.laning: In the jungle, use Fiddlesticks E Reap to group monsters and fully channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to maintain your health and clear speed. In the early game, before Bel'Veth builds stacks, delay her growth by stealing camps and large monsters during encounters where you have vision. Approach ganks from outside enemy vision. If a lane has a Control Ward, clear the vision or head to another lane.
Belveth.combo: Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right after Bel'Veth moves with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge or Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, or when finishing her off.
Belveth.escape: Dodging Bel'Veth W Above and Below prevents her Bel'Veth Q Void Surge reset, so look for a chance to engage. Bel'Veth Q Void Surge has a separate cooldown for each direction, but they come back quickly. Don't go in just because she has used it once; look for a chance to lock her down with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify before it comes back. Prepare Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of enemy vision.
Belveth.phase: Bel'Veth is weakest early, before she has stacks, so hinder her growth by contesting her early camps and large monsters. Fiddlesticks can still start objective team fights with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm in the late game, but Bel'Veth's permanent stacks put you at an increasing disadvantage as the game goes on.

Nocturne.watch: If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, don't run in a straight line along its trail; change your angle and move toward an ally or turret. Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror only fears you if the tether stays connected, so create distance to break it. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, casting Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right away will be blocked and greatly increase Nocturne's attack speed. If Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, don't get isolated; move toward your allies immediately.
Nocturne.build: Nocturne's main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. If you need to survive his burst, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. If healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon to maintain Grievous Wounds with the damage over time from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm.
Nocturne.fight: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is still available, pop the spell shield first with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then cast Fiddlesticks Q Terrify. Damage Nocturne first, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest all the way through when you can, to get its final damage and healing. After Nocturne R Paranoia is used, you have a chance to close the distance with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and catch him with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
Nocturne.combo: Open ganks from out of vision with Fiddlesticks E Reap to trigger your passive fear, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is available, pop the spell shield first with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify. In team fights, engage from out of vision with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, hit with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then cast Fiddlesticks Q Terrify on the target who can counterattack immediately and fully channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest.
Nocturne.escape: The window after Nocturne R Paranoia is used is your chance to go in. Break the tether from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and remove Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness before landing Fiddlesticks Q Terrify. Start Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from a spot with no enemy vision after Nocturne's key response abilities are used.
Nocturne.phase: Nocturne has no Nocturne R Paranoia during this window, so you can look for an opening without worrying about that ultimate. In the mid game, once you have Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and core Ability Power items, one engage can turn a team fight around. You can still start objective team fights in the late game, but Fiddlesticks is easy to kill if the enemies scatter after you engage.
